name: General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) Benchmark
description: The General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) benchmark is a collection of nine sentence- or sentence-pair language understanding tasks, including question answering, sentiment analysis, textual entailment, and linguistic acceptability, evaluated via a centralized public leaderboard.

publisher.name: New York University, University of Washington & DeepMind

license.name: Multiple / Upstream Task-Specific Licenses
license.notes: The official GLUE FAQ directs users to the original licenses of the component datasets. No unified reuse or commercial-use permission is inferred for the aggregate.

source_references.title: GLUE Benchmark Official Leaderboard
source_references.notes: Official benchmark website, dataset documentation, and leaderboard.

source_references.title: GLUE Benchmark FAQ
source_references.notes: Clarifies dataset provenance and specifies that users must check original licenses for each component task.

source_references.title: GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Natural Language Understanding
source_references.notes: Published in EMNLP 2018 BlackboxNLP Workshop by Alex Wang et al.
